summary: Revised documentation architecture plan for MOT firmware learning inside MOT/Docs/. Incorporates user feedback: (1) bootloader marked as learning-only, (2) separate REAL_TIME_EXAMPLES.md per firmware with register/memory-level execution flow, (3) Serial_Communication_Basics.md for frame formats (8N1 etc.) in Fundamentals, (4) corrected STM8→STM32 signal path: PWM→0-10V→voltage divider→ADC 12-bit (0-3.3V, 0-4095). Includes folder structure, system architecture diagram, wiring table, learning order, and style guidelines.
